capabilities: Import Apple Books highlights and notes into notes
Preserve user reflections across re-imports with a Keep Me section
Import a single book or the whole library
Back up existing highlight notes before overwriting
extras: README is promotional, with benchmark tables, a feature comparison against two rival plugins, and user testimonials; detailed setup and customization docs are linked elsewhere rather than included.
intentEvidence: This section compares performance of this plugin to two other contenders that were supposed to solve the import problem
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import Apple Books highlights and notes, and existing importers are slow, broken, or overwrite user-written thoughts.

relations.evidence: 70x faster than alternatives - save you up to 30min/month or up to 16hrs/year
The latest released version of apple-books-highlights (1.0.1) is broken (error when querying the Apple Books database)

summary: Imports Apple Books highlights and notes into Obsidian notes, preserving your own reflections across re-imports via a "Keep Me" section.
